229: static int send_slot(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
230:                      uint32_t *order)
231: {
232:   uint32_t wire[2];
233:   int ret;
234: 
235:   wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)message;
236:   wire[1] = sizeof(*message);
237:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
238:   ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
239:   if (ret == OK)
240:     {
241:       *order = ++g_send_order;
242:       g_stats.tx++;
243:     }
244:   else if (ret == -EAGAIN)
245:     {
246:       g_stats.fifo_full++;
247:     }
248: 
249:   return ret;
250: }

287: static void complete_transaction(struct active_transaction *active,
288:                                  const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
289:                                  int result)
290: {
291:   struct logical_channel *channel = NULL;

293:   if (active->channel_index < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)

295:       channel = &g_channels[active->channel_index];
296:       channel->queued = false;
297:       channel->result = result;
298:     }

300:   if (active->callback != NULL)
301:     {
302:       active->callback(ack, result, active->arg);
303:     }
304: 
305:   active->busy = false;
306:   if (result == OK)
307:     {
308:       release_acks_before(active->order);

321:         {

323:           channel->result = result;

328:         }

343: static void select_recovery_epoch(void)
344: {
345:   unsigned int i;
346:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = NULL;
347: 
348:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
349:     {
350:       if (!g_recovery[i].probe.quarantine &&
351:           !g_recovery[i].reset_sent && !g_recovery[i].probe.busy)
352:         {
353:           epoch = &g_recovery[i];
354:           g_recovery_index = i;
355:           break;
356:         }
357:     }
358: 
359:   if (epoch == NULL)
360:     {
361:       uint32_t newest = 0;
362: 
363:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
364:         {
365:           if (g_recovery[i].probe.order >= newest)
366:             {
367:               newest = g_recovery[i].probe.order;
368:               epoch = &g_recovery[i];
369:               g_recovery_index = i;
370:             }
371:         }
372: 
373:       epoch->replay = true;
374:       g_stats.recovery_replay++;
375:     }
376:   else
377:     {
378:       memset(epoch, 0, sizeof(*epoch));
379:       epoch->reset.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
380:         0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
381:         BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
382:     }
383: 
384:   g_probe_attempts = 0;
385:   g_reset_pending = !epoch->replay;
386:   g_stats.recovery_cycle++;
387:   set_link_state(epoch->replay ? BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING :
388:                                  BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
389: }

391: static void begin_abort(int result)
392: {
393:   struct active_transaction *probe = busy_probe();
394: 
395:   if (g_active.busy)
396:     {
397:       g_active.quarantine = true;
398:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
399:     }
400: 
401:   if (probe != NULL)
402:     {
403:       probe->quarantine = true;
404:       complete_transaction(probe, NULL, result);
405:     }
406: 
407:   fail_pending(result);
408:   g_probe_requested = false;
409:   select_recovery_epoch();
410: }

412: static struct ack_slot *alloc_ack_slot(void)
413: {
414:   unsigned int i;
415: 
416:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
417:     {
418:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
419:         {
420:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_QUEUED;
421:           return &g_ack_slots[i];
422:         }
423:     }
424: 
425:   g_stats.ack_overflow++;
426:   return NULL;
427: }

429: static int dispatch_locked(void)
430: {
431:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
432:   struct active_transaction *active;
433:   struct logical_channel *channel;
434:   unsigned int i;
435:   int ret;
436: 
437:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
438: 
439:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
440:     {
441:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
442:         {
443:           continue;
444:         }
445: 
446:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
447:       if (ret < 0)
448:         {
449:           return ret;
450:         }
451: 
452:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
453:     }
454: 
455:   if (g_reset_pending)
456:     {
457:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
458:       if (ret < 0)
459:         {
460:           return ret;
461:         }
462: 
463:       g_reset_pending = false;
464:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
465:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
466:     }
467: 
468:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
469:     {
470:       return OK;
471:     }
472: 
473:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
474:     {
475:       channel = &g_channels[i];
476:       if (!channel->queued)
477:         {
478:           continue;
479:         }
480: 
481:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
482:         {
483:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
484:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
485:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
486:             {
487:               continue;
488:             }
489: 
490:           active = &epoch->probe;
491:           if (active->quarantine && !epoch->replay)
492:             {
493:               return -ENOLINK;
494:             }
495:         }
496:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
497:         {
498:           active = &g_active;
499:           if (active->quarantine)
500:             {
501:               return -ENOLINK;
502:             }
503:         }
504:       else
505:         {
506:           return OK;
507:         }
508: 
509:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
510:         {
511:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
512:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
513:                  sizeof(active->message));
514:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
515:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
516:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
517:             g_channel_ids[i]);
518:         }
519: 
520:       active->callback = channel->callback;
521:       active->arg = channel->arg;
522:       active->channel_index = i;
523:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
524:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
525:       if (ret < 0)
526:         {
527:           return ret;
528:         }
529: 
530:       active->busy = true;
531:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
532:         {
533:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
534:             {
535:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
536:             }
537: 
538:           g_probe_attempts++;
539:           g_stats.probes++;
540:         }
541: 
542:       return OK;
543:     }
544: 
545:   return OK;
546: }

548: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
549:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
550: {
551:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
552: 
553:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
554:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
555:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
556:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
557:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
558:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
559:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
560: }
561: 
562: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
563: {
564:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
565:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
566:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
567: }
568: 
569: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
570: {
571:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
572:   struct active_transaction *active;
573:   bool replay;
574:   int result;
575: 
576:   active = busy_probe();
577:   if (active == NULL)
578:     {
579:       active = &g_active;
580:     }
581: 
582:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
583:     {
584:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
585:       return;
586:     }
587: 
588:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
589:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
590:     {
591:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
592: 
593:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
594:       return;
595:     }
596: 
597:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
598:     {
599:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
600:       return;
601:     }
602: 
603:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
604:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
605: 
606:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
607:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
608:     {
609:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
610:     }
611: 
612:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
613:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
614:   if (replay)
615:     {
616:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
617:       unsigned int i;
618: 
619:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
620:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
621:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
622:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
623:        */
624: 
625:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
626:       g_active.quarantine = false;
627:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
628:         {
629:           if (i != replay_index)
630:             {
631:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
632:             }
633:         }
634: 
635:       select_recovery_epoch();
636:       (void)dispatch_locked();
637:       return;
638:     }
639: 
640:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
641: 
642:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
643:     {
644:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
645:         {
646:           release_recovery_slots();
647:           g_recovery_index = 0;
648:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
649:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
650:         }
651:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
652:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
653:         {
654:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
655:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
656:            */
657:         }
658:       else
659:         {
660:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
661:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
662:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
663:         }
664:     }
665: 
666:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
667:            result < 0)
668:     {
669:       begin_abort(result);
670:     }
671: 
672:   (void)dispatch_locked();
673: }

675: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
676: {
677:   struct ack_slot *slot;
678:   unsigned int rx_index;
679:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
680:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
681:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
682:   uint8_t state = 0;
683:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
684: 
685:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
686:     {
687:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
688:       if (slot == NULL)
689:         {
690:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
691:           return -EAGAIN;
692:         }
693:     }
694:   else
695:     {
696:       slot = NULL;
697:     }
698: 
699:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
700:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
701:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
702:     {
703:       g_stats.bad_header++;
704:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
705:     }
706:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
707:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
708:     {
709:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
710:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
711:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
712:         {
713:           if (slot != NULL)
714:             {
715:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
716:             }
717: 
718:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
719:           return -EAGAIN;
720:         }
721:       else if (ret < 0)
722:         {
723:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
724:         }
725:     }
726:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
727:     {
728:       g_pwc_rx(message);
729:       ret = OK;
730:     }
731:   else
732:     {
733:       g_stats.unsupported++;
734:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
735:     }
736: 
737:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
738:     {

24:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 8  | \

29: static inline void bk7258_route_irq(int extirq, bool enable)
30: {
31:   uintptr_t regaddr;
32:   uint32_t bit;
33:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
34: 
35: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
36:   if (cpu == 1 && extirq != BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
37:     {
38:       return;
39:     }
40: #endif
41: 
42:   if (extirq < 32)
43:     {
44:       regaddr = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN0 : BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN0;
45:       bit = 1u << extirq;
46:     }
47:   else
48:     {
49:       regaddr = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1 : BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN1;
50:       bit = 1u << (extirq - 32);
51:     }
52: 
53:   if (enable)
54:     {
55:       modifyreg32(regaddr, 0, bit);
56:     }
57:   else
58:     {
59:       modifyreg32(regaddr, bit, 0);
60:     }
61: }

68:   int i;

70:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_EXTIRQ_COUNT; i += 32)
71:     {
72:       putreg32(0xffffffffu, NVIC_IRQ_CLEAR(i));
73:       putreg32(0xffffffffu, NVIC_IRQ_CLRPEND(i));
74:     }
75: 
76:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN0);
77:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN1);
78:   putreg32(0, NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL);
79: 
80:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH4_7_PRIORITY);
81:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
82:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH12_15_PRIORITY);
83: 
84:   priority_registers = ((getreg32(NVIC_ICTR) & 0x1f) + 1) * 8;
85:   regaddr = NVIC_IRQ0_3_PRIORITY;
86:   while (priority_registers-- > 0)
87:     {
88:       putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, regaddr);
89:       regaddr += 4;
90:     }
91: 
92:   bk7258_prioritize_svcall(NVIC_SYSH_SVCALL_PRIORITY);
93:   modifyreg32(NVIC_SYSHCON, 0,
94:               NVIC_SYSHCON_MEMFAULTENA | NVIC_SYSHCON_BUSFAULTENA |
95:               NVIC_SYSHCON_USGFAULTENA | NVIC_SYSHCON_SECUREFAULTENA);
96: }

99: static int bk7258_irqinfo(int irq, uintptr_t *regaddr, uint32_t *bit,
100:                           uintptr_t offset)
101: {
102:   int extirq;
103: 
104:   DEBUGASSERT(irq >= BK7258_IRQ_NMI && irq < NR_IRQS);
105: 
106:   if (irq >= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
107:     {
108:       extirq = irq - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST;
109:       *regaddr = NVIC_IRQ_ENABLE(extirq) + offset;
110:       *bit = 1u << (extirq & 31);
111:       return OK;
112:     }
113: 
114:   *regaddr = NVIC_SYSHCON;
115:   switch (irq)
116:     {
117:       case BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT:
118:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_MEMFAULTENA;
119:         break;
120:       case BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT:
121:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_BUSFAULTENA;
122:         break;
123:       case BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT:
124:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_USGFAULTENA;
125:         break;
126:       case BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT:
127:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_SECUREFAULTENA;
128:         break;
129:       case BK7258_IRQ_SYSTICK:
130:         *regaddr = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL;
131:         *bit = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_ENABLE;
132:         break;
133:       default:
134:         return ERROR;
135:     }
136: 
137:   return OK;
138: }

140: static inline void bk7258_prioritize_svcall(int priority)
141: {
142:   uint32_t regval = getreg32(NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
143:   regval &= ~NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR11_MASK;
144:   regval |= priority << NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR11_SHIFT;
145:   putreg32(regval, NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
146: }

157:     }
158: 
159:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN0);
160:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1);
161: 
162:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH4_7_PRIORITY);

164:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH12_15_PRIORITY);

167:   regaddr = NVIC_IRQ0_3_PRIORITY;

169:     {
170:       putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, regaddr);
171:       regaddr += 4;
172:     }

174:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_SVCALL, arm_svcall, NULL);
175:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_HARDFAULT, arm_hardfault, NULL);
176:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT, arm_memfault, NULL);
177:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT, arm_busfault, NULL);
178:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT, arm_usagefault, NULL);
179:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT, arm_securefault, NULL);
180:   arm_enable_dbgmonitor();
181:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_DBGMONITOR, arm_dbgmonitor, NULL);
182: 
183:   bk7258_prioritize_svcall(NVIC_SYSH_SVCALL_PRIORITY);
184:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT);
185:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT);

20: struct bk7258_psram_region
21: {
22:   const char *name;
23:   uintptr_t base;
24:   size_t size;
25: };
26: 
27: static const struct bk7258_psram_region g_pool_region[] =
28: {
29:   {"psram-user", BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_USER_BASE,
30:    BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_USER_SIZE},
31:   {"psram-audio", BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_AUDIO_BASE,
32:    BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_AUDIO_SIZE},
33:   {"psram-encode", BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_ENCODE_BASE,
34:    BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_ENCODE_SIZE},
35:   {"psram-display", BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_DISPLAY_BASE,
36:    BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_DISPLAY_SIZE},
37: };
38: 
39: static mutex_t g_psram_lock = NXMUTEX_INITIALIZER;
40: static struct mm_heap_s *g_psram_heap;
41: static struct mm_heap_s *g_pool_heap[BK7258_PSRAM_POOL_COUNT];
42: static uint32_t g_heap_allocations;
43: static uint32_t g_heap_failures;
44: static uint32_t g_pool_allocations[BK7258_PSRAM_POOL_COUNT];
45: static uint32_t g_pool_failures[BK7258_PSRAM_POOL_COUNT];
46: static uint32_t g_generation;
47: static enum bk7258_psram_state g_state = BK7258_PSRAM_OFF;
48: static int g_last_error;
49: 
50: static bool range_contains(uintptr_t base, size_t region_size,
51:                            const void *ptr, size_t size)
52: {
53:   uintptr_t address = (uintptr_t)ptr;
54:   uintptr_t end = base + region_size;
55: 
56:   return address >= base && address < end && size <= end - address;
57: }
58: 
59: static bool alignment_valid(size_t alignment)
60: {
61:   return alignment >= sizeof(uintptr_t) &&
62:          (alignment & (alignment - 1u)) == 0;
63: }
64: 
65: static int psram_probe(void)
66: {
67:   static const uintptr_t addresses[] =
68:   {
69:     BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_USER_BASE,
70:     BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_USER_BASE + BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_USER_SIZE - 4u,
71:     BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_AUDIO_BASE,
72:     BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_AUDIO_BASE + BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_AUDIO_SIZE - 4u,
73:     BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_ENCODE_BASE,
74:     BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_ENCODE_BASE + BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_ENCODE_SIZE - 4u,
75:     BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_DISPLAY_BASE,
76:     BK7258_PSRAM_BASE + 0x00400000u,
77:     BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_DISPLAY_BASE + BK7258_PSRAM_SLAB_DISPLAY_SIZE - 4u,
78:     BK7258_AP_PSRAM_HEAP_BASE,
79:     BK7258_PSRAM_BASE + 0x00800000u,
80:     BK7258_AP_PSRAM_HEAP_BASE + BK7258_AP_PSRAM_HEAP_SIZE - 4u,
81:     BK7258_AP_PSRAM_SECTION_BASE,
82:     BK7258_PSRAM_BASE + 0x00c00000u,
83:     BK7258_AP_PSRAM_SECTION_BASE + BK7258_AP_PSRAM_SECTION_SIZE - 4u,
84:   };
85:   uint32_t saved[sizeof(addresses) / sizeof(addresses[0])];
86:   size_t i;
87:   int ret = OK;
88: 
89:   for (i = 0; i < sizeof(addresses) / sizeof(addresses[0]); i++)
90:     {
91:       saved[i] = *(volatile uint32_t *)addresses[i];
92:     }
93: 
94:   for (i = 0; i < sizeof(addresses) / sizeof(addresses[0]); i++)
95:     {
96:       *(volatile uint32_t *)addresses[i] =
97:         0x72580000u ^ (uint32_t)(i * 0x01010101u);
98:     }
99: 
100:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
101:   for (i = 0; i < sizeof(addresses) / sizeof(addresses[0]); i++)
102:     {
103:       volatile uint32_t *word = (volatile uint32_t *)addresses[i];
104:       uint32_t expected = 0x72580000u ^ (uint32_t)(i * 0x01010101u);
105: 
106:       if (*word != expected)
107:         {
108:           ret = -EIO;
109:           break;
110:         }
111:     }
112: 
113:   for (i = 0; i < sizeof(addresses) / sizeof(addresses[0]); i++)
114:     {
115:       *(volatile uint32_t *)addresses[i] = saved[i];
116:     }
117: 
118:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
119:   return ret;
120: }
121: 
122: static void heap_info(struct bk7258_psram_heap_info *info,
123:                       struct mm_heap_s *heap, uintptr_t base, size_t size,
124:                       uint32_t allocations, uint32_t failures)
125: {
126:   struct mallinfo mall = mm_mallinfo(heap);
127: 
128:   info->base = base;
129:   info->size = size;
130:   info->arena = mall.arena;
131:   info->allocated = mall.uordblks;
132:   info->free = mall.fordblks;
133:   info->largest_free = mall.mxordblk;
134:   info->peak_allocated = mall.usmblks;
135:   info->allocation_count = allocations;
136:   info->failed_allocations = failures;
137: }

139: int bk7258_psram_initialize(void)
140: {
141:   unsigned int i = 0;
142:   int ret;
143: 
144:   nxmutex_lock(&g_psram_lock);
145:   if (g_state == BK7258_PSRAM_ONLINE)
146:     {
147:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_psram_lock);
148:       return OK;
149:     }
150: 
151:   g_state = BK7258_PSRAM_PROBING;
152:   /* printf("psram: probing configured region boundaries\n"); */
153:   ret = psram_probe();
154:   if (ret < 0)
155:     {
156:       goto fail;
157:     }
158: 
159:   /* printf("psram: boundary probe complete\n"); */
160:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_PSRAM_POOL_COUNT; i++)
161:     {
162:       /* printf("psram: initializing %s pool\n", g_pool_region[i].name); */
163:       g_pool_heap[i] = mm_initialize(g_pool_region[i].name,
164:                                      (void *)g_pool_region[i].base,
165:                                      g_pool_region[i].size);
166:       if (g_pool_heap[i] == NULL)
167:         {
168:           ret = -ENOMEM;
169:           goto fail;
170:         }
171:     }
172: 
173:   /* printf("psram: initializing AP heap\n"); */
174:   g_psram_heap = mm_initialize("bk7258-ap-psram",
175:                                (void *)BK7258_AP_PSRAM_HEAP_BASE,
176:                                BK7258_AP_PSRAM_HEAP_SIZE);
177:   if (g_psram_heap == NULL)
178:     {
179:       ret = -ENOMEM;
180:       goto fail;
181:     }
182: 
183:   g_generation++;
184:   g_last_error = OK;
185:   g_state = BK7258_PSRAM_ONLINE;
186:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_psram_lock);
187:   return OK;
188: 
189: fail:
190:   while (i > 0 && i <= BK7258_PSRAM_POOL_COUNT)
191:     {
192:       i--;
193:       mm_uninitialize(g_pool_heap[i]);
194:       g_pool_heap[i] = NULL;
195:     }
196: 
197:   g_last_error = ret;
198:   g_state = BK7258_PSRAM_FAILED;
199:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_psram_lock);
200:   return ret;
201: }
202: 
203: int bk7258_psram_shutdown(void)
204: {
205:   unsigned int i;
206: 
207:   nxmutex_lock(&g_psram_lock);
208:   if (g_state != BK7258_PSRAM_ONLINE)
209:     {
210:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_psram_lock);
211:       return -ENODEV;
212:     }
213: 
214:   g_state = BK7258_PSRAM_FREEZING;
215:   if (g_heap_allocations != 0)
216:     {
217:       g_state = BK7258_PSRAM_ONLINE;
218:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_psram_lock);
219:       return -EBUSY;
220:     }
221: 
222:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_PSRAM_POOL_COUNT; i++)
223:     {
224:       if (g_pool_allocations[i] != 0)
225:         {
226:           g_state = BK7258_PSRAM_ONLINE;
227:           nxmutex_unlock(&g_psram_lock);
228:           return -EBUSY;
229:         }
230:     }
231: 
232:   mm_uninitialize(g_psram_heap);
233:   g_psram_heap = NULL;
234:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_PSRAM_POOL_COUNT; i++)
235:     {
236:       mm_uninitialize(g_pool_heap[i]);
237:       g_pool_heap[i] = NULL;
238:     }
239: 
240:   g_state = BK7258_PSRAM_OFFLINE;
241:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_psram_lock);
242:   return OK;
243: }
244: 
245: void bk7258_psram_power_lost(void)
246: {
247:   nxmutex_lock(&g_psram_lock);
248:   g_psram_heap = NULL;
249:   memset(g_pool_heap, 0, sizeof(g_pool_heap));
250:   g_heap_allocations = 0;
251:   memset(g_pool_allocations, 0, sizeof(g_pool_allocations));
252:   g_generation++;
253:   g_last_error = -ENODEV;
254:   g_state = BK7258_PSRAM_FAILED;
255:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_psram_lock);
256: }

258: bool bk7258_psram_is_online(void)
259: {
260:   bool online;
261: 
262:   nxmutex_lock(&g_psram_lock);
263:   online = g_state == BK7258_PSRAM_ONLINE;
264:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_psram_lock);
265:   return online;

268: bool bk7258_psram_contains(const void *ptr, size_t size)
269: {
270:   unsigned int i;
271: 
272:   if (ptr == NULL)
273:     {
274:       return false;
275:     }
276: 
277:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_PSRAM_POOL_COUNT; i++)
278:     {
279:       if (range_contains(g_pool_region[i].base, g_pool_region[i].size,
280:                          ptr, size))
281:         {
282:           return true;
283:         }
284:     }
285: 
286:   return range_contains(BK7258_AP_PSRAM_HEAP_BASE,
287:                         BK7258_AP_PSRAM_HEAP_SIZE, ptr, size) ||
288:          range_contains(BK7258_AP_PSRAM_SECTION_BASE,
289:                         BK7258_AP_PSRAM_SECTION_SIZE, ptr, size);

292: void *bk7258_psram_malloc(size_t size)
293: {
294:   void *ptr = NULL;
295: 
296:   nxmutex_lock(&g_psram_lock);
297:   if (g_state == BK7258_PSRAM_ONLINE)
298:     {
299:       ptr = mm_malloc(g_psram_heap, size);
300:       if (ptr != NULL)
301:         {
302:           g_heap_allocations++;
303:         }
304:       else
305:         {
306:           g_heap_failures++;
307:         }
308:     }
309:   else
310:     {
311:       set_errno(ENODEV);
312:     }
313: 
314:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_psram_lock);
315:   return ptr;
316: }

318: void *bk7258_psram_zalloc(size_t size)
319: {
320:   void *ptr = bk7258_psram_malloc(size);
321:   if (ptr != NULL)
322:     {
323:       memset(ptr, 0, size);
324:     }

326:   return ptr;

329: void *bk7258_psram_calloc(size_t n, size_t elem_size)
330: {
331:   if (elem_size != 0 && n > SIZE_MAX / elem_size)
332:     {
333:       set_errno(ENOMEM);
334:       return NULL;
335:     }

184:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
185:   g_queue[g_head] = message;

326:   if (pid < 0)

330:   if (nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_worker_sem, MSEC2TICK(200)) < 0)
331:     {

333:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();

335:     }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 raw Mailbox SMP IPI.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <assert.h>
8: #include <errno.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <strings.h>
11: 
12: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
13: #include <nuttx/atomic.h>
14: #include <nuttx/sched.h>
15: 
16: #include "arm_internal.h"
17: #include "sched/sched.h"
18: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
19: #include "bk7258_smp.h"
20: 
21: #define BK7258_IPI_SCHED        (1u << 0)
22: #define BK7258_IPI_CALL         (1u << 1)
23: #define BK7258_IPI_BOOT_TEST    (1u << 2)
24: #define BK7258_IPI_RETRY_LIMIT  1024
25: 
26: static atomic_t g_ipi_pending[CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS];
27: static atomic_t g_ipi_kicked[CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS];
28: static atomic_t g_boot_seen[CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS];
29: 
30: static int bk7258_smp_kick(int cpu, uint32_t pending)
31: {
32:   uint32_t data[2] = {BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK, 0};
33:   int expected = 0;
34:   int retry;
35: 
36:   if ((unsigned int)cpu >= CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS || cpu == this_cpu())
37:     {
38:       return -EINVAL;
39:     }
40: 
41:   atomic_or_release(&g_ipi_pending[cpu], pending);
42:   if (!atomic_cmpxchg_acquire(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], &expected, 1))
43:     {
44:       return OK;
45:     }
46: 
47:   UP_DMB();
48:   for (retry = 0; retry < BK7258_IPI_RETRY_LIMIT; retry++)
49:     {
50:       int ret = bk7258_mbox_send((uint8_t)(cpu + 1), data);
51: 
52:       if (ret == OK)
53:         {
54:           return OK;
55:         }
56: 
57:       if (ret != -EAGAIN)
58:         {
59:           return ret;
60:         }
61: 
62:       __asm__ volatile("nop");
63:     }
64: 
65:   return -ETIMEDOUT;
66: }
67: 
68: void bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(int irq, void *context, uint32_t command)
69: {
70:   int cpu = this_cpu();
71: 
72:   if (command != BK7258_MBOX_RAW_KICK)
73:     {
74:       return;
75:     }
76: 
77:   for (;;)
78:     {
79:       uint32_t pending = atomic_xchg_acquire(&g_ipi_pending[cpu], 0);
80: 
81:       if ((pending & BK7258_IPI_CALL) != 0)
82:         {
83:           nxsched_smp_call_handler(irq, context, NULL);
84:         }
85: 
86:       if ((pending & BK7258_IPI_SCHED) != 0)
87:         {
88:           nxsched_process_delivered(cpu);
89:         }
90: 
91:       if ((pending & BK7258_IPI_BOOT_TEST) != 0)
92:         {
93:           atomic_set_release(&g_boot_seen[cpu], 1);
94:         }
95: 
96:       atomic_set_release(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 0);
97:       UP_DMB();
98:       if (atomic_read_acquire(&g_ipi_pending[cpu]) == 0)
99:         {
100:           break;
101:         }
102: 
103:       atomic_set_release(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 1);
104:     }
105: }
106: 
107: int up_send_smp_sched(int cpu)
108: {
109:   int ret = bk7258_smp_kick(cpu, BK7258_IPI_SCHED);
110: 
111:   if (ret < 0)
112:     {
113:       PANIC();
114:     }
115: 
116:   return ret;
117: }
118: 
119: void up_send_smp_call(cpu_set_t cpuset)
120: {
121:   int cpu;
122: 
123:   for (; cpuset != 0; cpuset &= ~(1u << cpu))
124:     {
125:       cpu = ffs((int)cpuset) - 1;
126:       if (cpu != this_cpu() && bk7258_smp_kick(cpu, BK7258_IPI_CALL) < 0)
127:         {
128:           PANIC();
129:         }
130:     }
131: }
132: 
133: void bk7258_smp_prepare_boot(void)
134: {
135:   int cpu;
136: 
137:   for (cpu = 0; cpu < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS; cpu++)
138:     {
139:       atomic_set(&g_ipi_pending[cpu], 0);
140:       atomic_set(&g_ipi_kicked[cpu], 0);
141:       atomic_set(&g_boot_seen[cpu], 0);
142:     }
143: }
144: 
145: void bk7258_smp_boot_notify(void)
146: {
147:   if (bk7258_smp_kick(0, BK7258_IPI_BOOT_TEST) < 0)
148:     {
149:       PANIC();
150:     }
151: }
152: 
153: bool bk7258_smp_boot_test_complete(void)
154: {
155:   return atomic_read_acquire(&g_boot_seen[0]) != 0 &&
156:          atomic_read_acquire(&g_boot_seen[1]) != 0;
157: }
158: 
159: int bk7258_smp_boot_ping(int cpu)
160: {
161:   return bk7258_smp_kick(cpu, BK7258_IPI_BOOT_TEST);
162: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 AP_SPINLOCK-backed software hwspinlock.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <assert.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: 
11: #include <nuttx/hwspinlock/hwspinlock.h>
12: 
13: #include "arm_internal.h"
14: 
15: static volatile uint32_t g_bk7258_atomic_gate
16:   __attribute__((section(".bk_spinlock"), aligned(32)));
17: 
18: static bool bk7258_hwspinlock_trylock(struct hwspinlock_dev_s *dev)
19: {
20:   uint32_t owner = (uint32_t)up_cpu_index() + 1u;
21:   uint32_t value;
22:   uint32_t status;
23: 
24:   (void)dev;
25:   __asm__ volatile
26:     (
27:       "ldaex %0, [%2]\n"
28:       "cmp %0, #0\n"
29:       "bne 1f\n"
30:       "strex %1, %3, [%2]\n"
31:       "b 2f\n"
32:       "1: clrex\n"
33:       "mov %1, #1\n"
34:       "2:\n"
35:       : "=&r"(value), "=&r"(status)
36:       : "r"(&g_bk7258_atomic_gate), "r"(owner)
37:       : "cc", "memory"
38:     );
39: 
40:   return value == 0 && status == 0;
41: }
42: 
43: static void bk7258_hwspinlock_relax(struct hwspinlock_dev_s *dev)
44: {
45:   (void)dev;
46:   __asm__ volatile("wfe" ::: "memory");
47: }
48: 
49: static void bk7258_hwspinlock_unlock(struct hwspinlock_dev_s *dev)
50: {
51:   uint32_t owner = (uint32_t)up_cpu_index() + 1u;
52:   uint32_t unlocked = 0;
53: 
54:   (void)dev;
55:   if (g_bk7258_atomic_gate != owner)
56:     {
57:       PANIC();
58:     }
59: 
60:   __asm__ volatile("stl %1, [%0]\n"
61:                    "dsb sy\n"
62:                    "sev\n"
63:                    :
64:                    : "r"(&g_bk7258_atomic_gate), "r"(unlocked)
65:                    : "memory");
66: }
67: 
68: const struct hwspinlock_ops_s g_bk7258_hwspinlock_ops =
69: {
70:   .trylock = bk7258_hwspinlock_trylock,
71:   .relax   = bk7258_hwspinlock_relax,
72:   .unlock  = bk7258_hwspinlock_unlock
73: };
74: 
75: void bk7258_hwspinlock_initialize(void)
76: {
77:   g_bk7258_atomic_gate = 0;
78:   UP_DSB();
79:   __asm__ volatile("sev" ::: "memory");
80: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 MBOX0 v2 physical transport.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <string.h>
11: 
12: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
13: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
14: 
15: #include "arm_internal.h"
16: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
17: #include "hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h"
18: #include "irq.h"
19: 
20: #define MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT      (2u * 3u + 1u)
21: 
22: struct mbox_rx_descriptor
23: {
24:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
25:   uint32_t order;
26:   bool used;
27: };
28: 
29: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
30: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor g_rx_desc[MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT];
31: static uint32_t g_rx_order;
32: static uint32_t g_processing_order;
33: static bool g_mbox_ready;
34: static bool g_mbox_smp_ready;
35: static struct bk7258_mbox_stats g_stats;
36: 
37: _Static_assert(MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT > 2u * 3u,
38:                "RX descriptors must hold a deferred command and two FIFOs");
39: 
40: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
41: {
42:   return getreg32(up_cpu_index() == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
43:                                        BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS);
44: }
45: 
46: static void mbox_clear_errors(int cpu)
47: {
48:   uintptr_t cfg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG;
49:   uint32_t config = getreg32(cfg);
50:   uint32_t errors = config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
51: 
52:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
53:     {
54:       g_stats.write_error++;
55:     }
56: 
57:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
58:     {
59:       g_stats.read_error++;
60:     }
61: 
62:   if (cpu == 0 && (errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
63:     {
64:       g_stats.write_full++;
65:     }
66: 
67:   if (errors != 0)
68:     {
69:       putreg32((config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors, cfg);
70:     }
71: }
72: 
73: static bool mbox_valid_envelope(uint8_t source, uint32_t address,
74:                                 uint32_t length)
75: {
76:   if (source != 0)
77:     {
78:       g_stats.bad_source++;
79:       return false;
80:     }
81: 
82:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
83:     {
84:       g_stats.bad_length++;
85:       return false;
86:     }
87: 
88:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
89:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
90:     {
91:       g_stats.bad_address++;
92:       return false;
93:     }
94: 
95:   return true;
96: }
97: 
98: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
99: {
100:   uintptr_t status;
101:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
102: 
103:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 2 || data == NULL)
104:     {
105:       return -EINVAL;
106:     }
107: 
108: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
109:   if (cpu == 1 && (destination != 1 || data[1] != 0))
110:     {
111:       return -EPERM;
112:     }
113: #endif
114: 
115:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
116:    * receive FIFO status register.
117:    */
118: 
119:   status = destination == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH0_STATUS :
120:             destination == 1 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS :
121:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_STATUS;
122:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
123:     {
124:       return -EAGAIN;
125:     }
126: 
127:   putreg32(data[0], cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA0 :
128:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA0);
129:   putreg32(data[1], cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA1 :
130:                                BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TDATA1);
131:   putreg32(destination, cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TID :
132:                                   BK7258_MBOX_CH2_TID);
133:   return OK;
134: }
135: 
136: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_alloc_desc(void)
137: {
138:   unsigned int i;
139: 
140:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
141:     {
142:       if (!g_rx_desc[i].used)
143:         {
144:           return &g_rx_desc[i];
145:         }
146:     }
147: 
148:   return NULL;
149: }
150: 
151: static bool mbox_priority_message(
152:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
153: {
154:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
155: 
156:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;
157: }
158: 
159: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
160: {
161:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
162:   unsigned int i;
163: 
164:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
165:     {
166:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
167: 
168:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
169:         {
170:           continue;
171:         }
172: 
173:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
174:         {
175:           oldest = desc;
176:         }
177:     }
178: 
179:   return oldest;
180: }
181: 
182: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
183: {
184:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
185:   int ret;
186: 
187:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
188:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
189:    */
190: 
191:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
192:     {
193:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
194:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
195:       g_processing_order = 0;
196:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
197:         {
198:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
199:           break;
200:         }
201: 
202:       desc->used = false;
203:     }
204: 
205:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
206:     {
207:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
208:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
209:       g_processing_order = 0;
210:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
211:         {
212:           break;
213:         }
214: 
215:       desc->used = false;
216:     }
217: }
218: 
219: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
220: {
221:   uintptr_t rdata0;
222:   uintptr_t rdata1;
223:   uintptr_t sidreg;
224:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();
225: 
226:   (void)irq;
227:   (void)context;
228:   (void)arg;
229: 
230:   mbox_clear_errors(cpu);
231:   sidreg = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_SID;
232:   rdata0 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA0;
233:   rdata1 = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 : BK7258_MBOX_CH2_RDATA1;
234: 
235:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
236:     {
237:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
238:       uint32_t address;
239:       uint32_t length;
240:       uint8_t source;
241: 
242:       if (cpu == 0)
243:         {
244:           mbox_process_desc();
245:         }
246: 
247:       desc = cpu == 0 ? mbox_alloc_desc() : NULL;
248:       if (cpu == 0 && desc == NULL)
249:         {
250:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
251:           break;
252:         }
253: 
254:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
255:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
256:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
257: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
258:       if (length == 0)
259:         {
260:           if (source == (uint8_t)(2 - cpu))
261:             {
262:               bk7258_smp_ipi_receive(irq, context, address);
263:             }
264:           else
265:             {
266:               if (cpu == 0)
267:                 {
268:                   g_stats.bad_source++;
269:                 }
270:             }
271: 
272:           continue;
273:         }
274: #endif
275: 
276:       if (cpu != 0)
277:         {
278:           continue;
279:         }
280: 
281:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
282:         {
283:           continue;
284:         }
285: 
286:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
287:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
288:              sizeof(desc->message));
289:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
290:       desc->used = true;
291:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
292:       mbox_process_desc();
293:     }
294: 
295:   if (cpu == 0)
296:     {
297:       mbox_process_desc();
298:     }
299: 
300:   return OK;
301: }
302: 
303: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)
304: {
305:   g_callback = callback;
306: }
307: 
308: void bk7258_mbox_kick_rx(void)
309: {
310:   irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
311: 
312:   (void)bk7258_mbox_irq(0, NULL, NULL);
313:   up_irq_restore(flags);
314: }
315: 
316: void bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred(void)
317: {
318:   unsigned int i;
319: 
320:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
321:     {
322:       if (g_rx_desc[i].used && g_processing_order != 0 &&
323:           (int32_t)(g_rx_desc[i].order - g_processing_order) < 0 &&
324:           !mbox_priority_message(&g_rx_desc[i].message))
325:         {
326:           g_rx_desc[i].used = false;
327:         }
328:     }
329: }
330: 
331: void bk7258_mbox_get_stats(struct bk7258_mbox_stats *stats)
332: {
333:   irqstate_t flags;
334: 
335:   if (stats == NULL)
336:     {
337:       return;
338:     }
339: 
340:   flags = up_irq_save();
341:   *stats = g_stats;
342:   up_irq_restore(flags);
343: }
344: 
345: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
346: {
347:   int ret;
348: 
349:   if (g_mbox_ready)
350:     {
351:       return OK;
352:     }
353: 
354:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));
355:   g_rx_order = 0;
356:   g_processing_order = 0;
357:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
358: 
359:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
360:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
361:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
362:    */
363: 
364:   putreg32(2u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
365:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
366:             BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG);
367:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
368: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
369:   putreg32(5u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
370:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
371:             BK7258_MBOX_CH2_CFG);

367: static void pwc_rx(const void *raw)
368: {
369:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
370:   struct pwc_message message;
371:   unsigned int next;
372:   irqstate_t flags;
373: 
374:   if (bytes == NULL)
375:     {
376:       return;
377:     }
378: 
379:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
380:   next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
381:   if (next == g_tail)
382:     {
383:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
384:       return;
385:     }
386: 
387:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
388:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
389:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
390:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
391:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
392:   g_head = next;
393:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
394:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
395: }

397: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
398: {
399:   int ret;
400: 
401:   (void)argc;
402:   (void)argv;
403:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
404:   g_worker_result = ret < 0 ? -EXDEV : OK;
405:   g_worker_ready = ret >= 0;
406:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
407:   if (ret < 0)
408:     {
409:       return -EXDEV;
410:     }
411: 
412:   for (;;)
413:     {
414:       struct pwc_message message;
415:       irqstate_t flags;
416: 
417:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
418:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
419:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
420:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
421:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
422:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
423:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
424:         {
425:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
426:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
427:             if (g_psram_power_waiting &&
428:                 message.param1 == g_psram_power_expected_state)
429:               {
430:                 g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
431:                 g_psram_power_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
432:                 g_psram_power_version = message.param3;
433:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
434:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
435:               }
436:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
437:             break;
438: 
439:           case PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD:
440:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
441:             if (g_openvela_ready_waiting &&
442:                 message.param1 == g_openvela_ready_expected)
443:               {
444:                 g_openvela_ready_echo = message.param1;
445:                 g_openvela_ready_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
446:                 g_openvela_ready_version = message.param3;
447:                 g_openvela_ready_received = true;
448:                 g_openvela_ready_waiting = false;
449:                 nxsem_post(&g_openvela_ready_sem);
450:               }
451:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
452:             break;
453: 
454: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
455:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
456:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
457:               {
458:                 ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
459:                         PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
460:                         PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
461:                         bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
462:                 if (ret != OK)
463:                   {
464:                     printf("PWC: PSRAM malloc state response failed, "
465:                            "error=%d\n", ret);
466:                   }
467:               }
468:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
469:               {
470:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
471: 
472:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
473:               }
474:             break;
475: 
476:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
477:             bk7258_psram_dump();
478:             break;
479: 
480:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
481:             {
482: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
483:               ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
484:                       PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT,
485:                       (uint32_t)-ENOTSUP, 0);
486: #else
487:               int shutdown_ret = bk7258_psram_shutdown();
488: 
489:               ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
490:                       PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
491:                       shutdown_ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
492:                                           PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT,
493:                       0);
494: #endif
495:               if (ret != OK)
496:                 {
497:                   printf("PWC: recovery response failed, error=%d\n", ret);
498:                 }
499:             }
500:             break;
501: #endif
502: 
503:           default:
504:             break;
505:         }
506:     }
507:   return 0;
508: }

429: static int dispatch_locked(void)
430: {
431:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
432:   struct active_transaction *active;
433:   struct logical_channel *channel;
434:   unsigned int i;
435:   int ret;
436: 
437:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
438: 
439:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
440:     {
441:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
442:         {
443:           continue;
444:         }
445: 
446:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
447:       if (ret < 0)
448:         {
449:           return ret;
450:         }
451: 
452:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
453:     }
454: 
455:   if (g_reset_pending)
456:     {
457:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
458:       if (ret < 0)
459:         {
460:           return ret;
461:         }
462: 
463:       g_reset_pending = false;
464:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
465:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
466:     }
467: 
468:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
469:     {
470:       return OK;
471:     }
472: 
473:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
474:     {
475:       channel = &g_channels[i];
476:       if (!channel->queued)
477:         {
478:           continue;
479:         }
480: 
481:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
482:         {
483:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
484:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
485:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
486:             {
487:               continue;
488:             }
489: 
490:           active = &epoch->probe;
491:           if (active->quarantine && !epoch->replay)
492:             {
493:               return -ENOLINK;
494:             }
495:         }
496:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
497:         {
498:           active = &g_active;
499:           if (active->quarantine)
500:             {
501:               return -ENOLINK;
502:             }
503:         }
504:       else
505:         {
506:           return OK;
507:         }
508: 
509:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
510:         {
511:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
512:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
513:                  sizeof(active->message));
514:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
515:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
516:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
517:             g_channel_ids[i]);
518:         }
519: 
520:       active->callback = channel->callback;
521:       active->arg = channel->arg;
522:       active->channel_index = i;
523:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
524:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
525:       if (ret < 0)
526:         {
527:           return ret;
528:         }
529: 
530:       active->busy = true;
531:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
532:         {
533:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
534:             {
535:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
536:             }
537: 
538:           g_probe_attempts++;
539:           g_stats.probes++;
540:         }
541: 
542:       return OK;
543:     }
544: 
545:   return OK;
546: }

548: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
549:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
550: {
551:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
552: 
553:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
554:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
555:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
556:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
557:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
558:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
559:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
560: }

562: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
563: {
564:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
565:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
566:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
567: }

569: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
570: {
571:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
572:   struct active_transaction *active;
573:   bool replay;
574:   int result;
575: 
576:   active = busy_probe();
577:   if (active == NULL)
578:     {
579:       active = &g_active;
580:     }
581: 
582:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
583:     {
584:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
585:       return;
586:     }
587: 
588:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
589:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
590:     {
591:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
592: 
593:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
594:       return;
595:     }
596: 
597:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
598:     {
599:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
600:       return;
601:     }
602: 
603:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
604:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
605: 
606:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
607:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
608:     {
609:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
610:     }
611: 
612:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
613:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
614:   if (replay)
615:     {
616:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
617:       unsigned int i;
618: 
619:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
620:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
621:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
622:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
623:        */
624: 
625:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
626:       g_active.quarantine = false;
627:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
628:         {
629:           if (i != replay_index)
630:             {
631:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
632:             }
633:         }
634: 
635:       select_recovery_epoch();
636:       (void)dispatch_locked();
637:       return;
638:     }
639: 
640:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
641: 
642:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
643:     {
644:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
645:         {
646:           release_recovery_slots();
647:           g_recovery_index = 0;
648:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
649:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
650:         }
651:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
652:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
653:         {
654:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
655:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
656:            */
657:         }
658:       else
659:         {
660:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
661:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
662:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
663:         }
664:     }
665: 
666:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
667:            result < 0)
668:     {
669:       begin_abort(result);
670:     }
671: 
672:   (void)dispatch_locked();
673: }

675: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
676: {
677:   struct ack_slot *slot;
678:   unsigned int rx_index;
679:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
680:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
681:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
682:   uint8_t state = 0;
683:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
684: 
685:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
686:     {
687:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
688:       if (slot == NULL)
689:         {
690:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
691:           return -EAGAIN;
692:         }
693:     }
694:   else
695:     {
696:       slot = NULL;
697:     }
698: 
699:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
700:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
701:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
702:     {
703:       g_stats.bad_header++;
704:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
705:     }
706:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
707:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
708:     {
709:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
710:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
711:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
712:         {
713:           if (slot != NULL)
714:             {
715:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
716:             }
717: 
718:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
719:           return -EAGAIN;
720:         }
721:       else if (ret < 0)
722:         {
723:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
724:         }
725:     }
726:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
727:     {
728:       g_pwc_rx(message);
729:       ret = OK;
730:     }
731:   else
732:     {
733:       g_stats.unsupported++;
734:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
735:     }
736: 
737:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
738:     {
739:       return OK;
740:     }
741: 
742:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
743:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
744:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
745:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
746:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
747: 
748:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
749:     {
750:       g_probe_requested = true;
751:     }
752: 
753:   (void)dispatch_locked();
754:   return OK;
755: }

757: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
758: {
759:   irqstate_t flags;
760:   uint8_t control;
761: 
762:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
763:   g_stats.rx++;
764:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
765: 
766:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
767:     {
768:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
769:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
770:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
771:         {
772:           g_stats.bad_header++;
773:         }
774:       else
775:         {
776:           g_stats.resets++;
777:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
778:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();
779:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);

782:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)

787:     {
788:       int ret = handle_command(message);

790:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
791:         {
792:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
793:           return ret;
794:         }
795:     }
796: 
797:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
798:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
